## Audit File Summary & Handoff Breadcrumbs

All 20 MSA audit files have been moved to `Data/Pages/Audits/`. Below is a categorized summary of every file, with criticality ratings and synthesis notes for agents.

---

### Category 1: Sprint 58 Wave D / dev/round-3 Deep Audits (Most Authoritative — 8 files)

These are from a single deep-audit session on 2026-07-01 (commit `57b8fdf79`), with delta passes building on each other. They're the most internally consistent set. Start here.

| File | Key Findings | Priority |
|---|---|---|
| `msa_sprint58_deep_audit_dev_round3_20260701_1500_CT.md` | **Critical F1: WorldModel.Predict tool-name mismatch** — uses wire-protocol lowercase (`move`, `mine`, `craft`) but called with PascalCase tool names (`MineBlock`, `CraftItem`). This silently defeats TSK-0309/TSK-0334 prediction pipeline. Every mine/craft/smelt produces no predicted inventory delta, so LLM evaluator fast-path is effectively disabled for normal gameplay. **Zero unit tests on `WorldModel.Predict()` enabled this to ship.** Also: F2 (IGoalPrecondition wired only into dead path), F3 (evaluator has no TaskSequenceGoal branch), F4 (replanning never receives evaluator diagnosis), F5 (chained navigate step dropped), F6 (HtnPlanner doc claims type-switches removed — they're not), F7 (TaskSequenceGoalDecomposer hard-throws), F8 (dead Navigate branch), F9 (WorldModel has zero tests). | **P0** |
| `msa_sprint58_deep_audit_dev_round3_20260701_1615_CT_DELTA.md` | **Critical DI constructor defect: `HtnTaskLibrary`** has 2 constructors, one leaves `_methods` empty, production DI registration is bare (`AddSingleton<HtnTaskLibrary>()` without factory). Container's documented algorithm may select the empty one. 11 task decomposers (GatherWood, SurviveNight, etc.) silently non-functional if so. Also: ReplanGovernor stall backoff off-by-one (first stall waits 10s not 5s, tier 0 unreachable). | **P0-verify** |
| `msa_sprint58_deep_audit_delta2_dev_round3_20260701_1830_CT.md` | **F16: WebSocketBridge reconnect loop silently aborts after 1 failed attempt** instead of retrying 3 times. A failed reconnect leaves `_ws.State != Open`, then `ReceiveLoopAsync` returns immediately (no throw), so the retry loop exits cleanly. The "permanently deaf" LogError is never reached. **F10: HtnTaskLibrary ctor issue** (same as above, independently verified). **F11: ReplanGovernor stall backoff broken** (tiers 0 and 3-4 unreachable). **F12: Alias/fuzzy-resolution layer entirely dead code** (doc comment claims otherwise). **F13: ResolveCraftItem latent bug** inside dead code. **F14: GatherWoodGoal + SurviveNightGoal unreachable** via any live chat/intent path. | **P1** |
| `msa_sprint58_deep_audit_delta3_dev_round3_20260701_2100_CT.md` | **F16 confirmed: WebSocketBridge gives up after 1 attempt.** **F15: HtnPlanner/BuildGoalDecomposer each have their own ReadOriginFact** — copies already diverged (HtnPlanner's cruder, no `found` out-param). Currently dead path but demonstrates duplication risk. **F17: Recurring "built but never cut over" pattern** — 4 independently verified instances (manager layer, IGoalPrecondition, AliasRegistry, LocalKnowledgeResolver). | **P1** |
| `msa_sprint58_deep_audit_delta4_dev_round3_20260701_2330_CT.md` | **F18: Node adapter reconnect exponential backoff defeated by premature counter reset** (`_reconnectAttempts = 0` at start of `connectBot()`, unconditionally). Same bug family as F11/F16 — third independent retry mechanism with broken escalation. `"reconnected successfully"` log fires before TCP handshake completes. **F19: `classifyError()` substring matching fragile** (`.includes('no')` matches `not`, `node`, `ignore`). **F20: `ActionFailedEvent.ReasonCode` is only ever logged, never branched on** — fifth F17 pattern instance. | **P1** |
| `msa_deep_audit_dev_round3_20260701_1500_CT.md` | Full deep audit (same session). Confirmed Sprint 58 closed 13/16 tracked P0-P2 findings. **F1: WorldModel.Predict mismatch** (same as above). **Method note:** "This codebase has been audited at least 20 times before" — 55 files in existing Data/Pages/Audits. | **P0** |
| `msa_deep_audit_dev_round3_20260701_delta_CT.md` | **Finding 1: MemorySmithItemRegistry missing TSK-0109 cancellation fix** (sibling class `MemorySmithBlueprintRepository` got it). **Finding 2: 11/14 tools re-parse JSON schema on every dispatch** — 3 tools already fixed to `static readonly JsonDocument`, 11 not. **Finding 3: WebSocketBridge permanent-deaf has no escalation** — `IsConnected` is read by nothing, no watchdog or dashboard tile. | **P2** |
| `msa_deep_audit_dev_round3_20260701_delta2_CT.md` | **Finding 1: DashboardPublisherImpl is a second, divergent, buggier reimplementation** of what ABS already does live (hardcoded 0 for queued, can never report "active"). Delete, don't finish wiring. **Finding 2: Both file-based loggers (C# FileChatLogger + JS logger.js) swallow I/O failures silently** — empty catches, no secondary channel. **Finding 3: movements.js Movements singleton stale after TSK-0263 reconnect.** **Finding 4: FileChatLogger uses ReaderWriterLockSlim for write-only access pattern.** | **P2** |
| `msa_deep_audit_dev_round3_20260701_delta3_CT.md` | **Finding 1: 3/4 LLM providers silently swallow HTTP failures** (Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAICompatible — Ollama does it right with status+body logging). **Finding 2: Gemini API key in URL** (defense-in-depth). **Finding 3: Checked-in appsettings.json re-enables `CommandExecutionEnabled: true`** and `AllowDestructiveCommands: true`, undoing TSK-0319's safe-by-default code change. **Finding 4: ChatRateLimiter.Prune() fully implemented with zero callers** — another F17 instance. | **P2** |

## Top Synthesis Priorities for Agent Review

These are the highest-leverage items to convert into tasks after critical review:

### P0 — Fix Immediately
1. **WorldModel.Predict tool-name mismatch** — change switch cases from wire-protocol lowercase to `ITool.Name` PascalCase (`"MineBlock"`, `"CraftItem"`, etc.). Add unit tests for `Predict()`. This silently defeats TSK-0309/TSK-0334 prediction pipeline.
2. **HtnTaskLibrary DI constructor** — switch to explicit factory `sp => new HtnTaskLibrary()` in `Program.cs`. Add regression test that resolves through `ServiceCollection`.
3. **WebSocketBridge reconnect loop** — fix so a failed reconnect doesn't exit the retry loop (distinguish "socket never opened" from "connection closed cleanly").

### P1 — This Sprint
4. **3 retry/backoff mechanisms, 3 broken** — ReplanGovernor (F11), WebSocketBridge (F16), Node adapter reconnect (F18). Each has a different root cause but all fail to escalate.
5. **Chat command bypass via leading whitespace** — `" /give ..."` bypasses `/` check.
6. **Inventory double-count** — `ApplyBlockMined` + `ApplyItemCollected` both increment inventory.
7. **Creative smelt shortcut gives wrong item** — gives input not output.
8. **Count handling inconsistent** — zero counts produce immediately-complete goals.
9. **LLM providers silently swallow HTTP failures** — port OllamaProvider's logging pattern to other 3 providers.
10. **appsettings.json re-enables CommandExecutionEnabled** — move permissive config to gitignored override.

### P2 — Next Sprint
11. **11/14 tools re-parse JSON schema per dispatch** — already-fixed pattern exists in 3 tools.
12. **File loggers silently swallow I/O failures** — both C# FileChatLogger and JS logger.js.
13. **MemorySmithItemRegistry missing cancellation fix** — sibling class already fixed.
14. **DashboardPublisherImpl is superseded dead code** — delete it.
15. **Built-but-never-cut-over subsystems** — 5 confirmed instances. Add "wired into live path" AC to future tasks.
16. **ChatRateLimiter.Prune() never called** — wire it into a background timer or delete.
17. **WebSocketBridge permanent-deaf escalation** — surface terminal failure to ABS.
18. **AliasRegistry dead code** — wire into GoalFactory or delete.
19. **Standardize context-carry key names** — `nearestWoodX/Y/Z` vs `nearestX/Y/Z` mismatch.

### Architectural Debt (Long-term)
20. **ABS still owns too much policy** — TSK-0292/0293 extraction is the most impactful architectural work.
21. **Sprint/version metadata drift** — centralize into a single manifest.
22. **Decomposer ordering hidden contract** — `PlaceBlockGoalDecomposer` must be registered before `GatherGoalDecomposer`.
23. **Duplicate retry/backoff logic across 3 subsystems** — consider a shared utility.

---

## Cross-Reference: Existing Audit Docs

The MSA repo already had ~55 existing audit files in `Data/Pages/Audits/`. The most important for cross-reference:
- `internal-audit-57-20260701.md` — the audit that Sprint 58 Waves C/D resolved 13/16 findings from.
- `Data/Pages/council/*` — council reviews, especially `council-review-msa-audit-6-27-26.md`.
- Existing Sprint 58 handoff docs in `Data/Pages/Handoffs/`.

**When synthesizing, check existing tasks (especially TSK-0292, TSK-0293, TSK-0322, TSK-0310, TSK-0311, TSK-0313) before creating new ones.**
